rationale: The plan matches the reference: the balanced batch enters as a covariate in ~ batch + condition, counts are not pre-adjusted, and DESeq2 Wald with apeglm plus an edgeR QL cross-check on the same design are used. QC is blind VST PCA and distances colored by both batch and condition with library sizes and an explicit flag-don't-drop outlier policy. The pre-filter (>=10 in >=6 samples) is minimal and tied to group size, normalization stays inside the models, the reference level and contrast are explicit, and BH at alpha 0.05 is set in results() with shrinkage for reported effects. Enrichment was not requested but is specified correctly (full ranked list, Wald stat named, 15-500 window, universe and collection versions stated); the report enumerates methods, versions, design, thresholds, counts and small-n caveats, though the batch-design caveat itself is only implicit.
